reason: A Windows-focused dsh plugin that notifies users about agent and session events through native toast notifications and provides a configurable system tray interface.

summaries.zh: 通过 Windows 原生通知和系统托盘图标提醒用户 dsh 智能体及会话状态变化的插件。
summaries.en: A dsh plugin that uses Windows native notifications and a system tray icon to report agent and session state changes.

capabilities: Displays Windows native toast notifications for agent and session state changes
Maintains a Windows system tray icon
Provides tray actions to open the dsh web page and exit the background process
Supports notification filtering and cooldown configuration
